author: Google
description:
The Google Pixel 10a is officially here! Join Product Manager Laura Castilani as she reveals how Google re-engineered the A-Series to include a zero-millimeter flush camera bar and flagship AI features. 

In this episode of the Made by Google Podcast, we dive into the Pixel 10a’s massive battery upgrades, the arrival of Satellite SOS, and why this is our most durable and sustainable phone yet. From the vibrant "Berry" color to 7 years of software updates, discover why the Pixel 10a is the ultimate $499 powerhouse. 

00:00 - Introduction to Pixel 10a
02:14 - Redesigning the Camera Bar
03:44 - Advanced AI: Gemini Live & Photography
06:47 - Safety and Longevity
10:19 - Sustainability and Vibrant New Colors
